mood: Torn into the dark behind the world, Vexana falls, and the star at her collar will not go out.

hero.alt: Vexana in her Academy uniform falls head first through the dark, arms open and eyes closed, her long black hair streaming around her.
hero.credit: Official Guinevere and Vexana comic, page 19

media.alt: Falling upside down, Vexana closes her gloved hand over the gold star at her collar, and light bursts across her wet, wide-open eyes.
media.credit: Official Guinevere and Vexana comic, page 21

media.alt: Vexana falls through the dark wrapped in rays of light; then, close, the gold star at her collar shines over her face.
media.credit: Official Guinevere and Vexana motion comic

media.alt: Comic panel: a black crack splits a blue sky and silver claws push through it, while a bubble says find a way.
media.credit: Official Guinevere and Vexana comic, page 34

media.alt: Comic panel: Guinevere sits in the grass, eyes shut and grinning, one fist thrust at the sky, as the claw hangs through the crack over her head.
media.credit: Official Guinevere and Vexana comic, page 35
